summary: ARTFUL Phase-1 storefront verification: newsletter/contact/settings/CMS/categories/customer profile/order flow (DEV OTP + mock-pay + SMS DEV log) + cancel-order (with SMS DEV log). 16/16 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end: header logo + theme toggle (persists across reload) + nav-about → /about, cookie consent (accept/settings/save + footer reopen), hero carousel with next/prev/dots + trust badges (7-Day Easy Returns / Best Quality / Best Price), category marquee (16 chips, click navigates to /categories/<slug>), Why ARTFUL 4 value cards, ARTFUL Promise section, newsletter footer form → thank-you popup with Continue button, contact page shows Indore address + phone + support email + form submits with success toast, checkout qty +/- controls update total (₹1,399 → ₹2,798), profile edit (name/phone/email) saves, cancel-order modal on /account/orders/:num shows Terms (/terms) + Refund (/returns) links, checkbox gates confirm button (disabled → enabled), order transitions to Cancelled, /order-success/:num shows confetti canvas + order number. Scrollbar width = 0 as required.

issues: data-testid='contact-email' is applied to a wrapper <div> rather than the actual <input> — Playwright fill() fails on that testid. Consider moving the testid onto the <input> for reliable automation. Not user-facing; contact form still submits via other selectors.

backend_endpoints_tested: GET /api/cms/homepage (hero.slides >=3 w/ badges, promise section, why_artful/values items with icons)
POST /api/orders/{order_number}/cancel + backend log verification of [sms][DEV] confirmed & cancelled lines for +919876543210
frontend_flows_verified: Home: logo, footer-logo, theme-toggle (light→dark persists reload), nav-about → /about
Cookie: banner shows on fresh visit, Settings → Save hides it, persists reload, footer-cookie-settings reopens
Hero: hero-section, hero-next/prev, hero-dots(3), hero-trust-badges: '7-Day Easy Returns / Best Quality / Best Price'
Category marquee: 16 chips, marquee-cat-artistic-gifts navigates to /categories/artistic-gifts
Why ARTFUL: value-card-0..3 present; artful-promise-section present
Newsletter footer: submit → newsletter-thankyou popup + Continue button
Contact page: Indore address + +91 8871288853 + support@artful.com visible, form submits with thank-you text
Checkout /checkout: checkout-qty-inc/dec/remove present, incrementing qty updates total (₹1,399 → ₹2,798)
Profile /account: profile-name/phone/email/save present + save shows success

Cancel modal /account/orders/:num: cancel-order-btn → cancel-order-modal, checkbox required (confirm disabled true→false), terms href=/terms, refund href=/returns, confirm cancels order (status=Cancelled)
Order success /order-success/:num: renders order number, confetti canvas present

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Move data-testid='contact-email' from wrapper div onto the underlying <input> for stable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: mock-pay endpoint accepts {order_id} (uuid) not {order_number}; if Razorpay is enabled, mock-pay returns 400 — spec text mentions 'create-order then mock-pay' but current DEV order flow with COD is what most tests exercise. Consider normalising mock-pay to accept order_number too, since the frontend and admin operate on order_number everywhere else.
In routers_shop.update_me: PHONE_RE only validates when payload.phone is truthy; setting phone to empty string via {phone:''} is silently ignored (no clear/unlink). Fine if intentional.
CategoryMarquee has 16 chips — several duplicates (Artistic Gifts appears twice due to marquee looping) is expected for continuous scroll effect; not a bug.
test_credentials: Customer via DEV OTP; POST /api/auth/otp/send {phone:'9876543210'} → dev_otp field in response.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 test COD orders (ART-2026-00003..5+) and several TEST_ newsletter/contact rows during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order detail path is /account/orders/:num (NOT /orders/:num). mock-pay payload key is 'order_id' (UUID from GET /api/orders/{num}.id), not 'order_number'. Auth token key in localStorage is 'artful_token'. Cookie banner appears on every fresh browser (no consent stored) — use ?noloader=1 to bypass the BrandLoader.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. One minor testability nit only (contact-email testid on wrapper div).
